events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Known for his distinctive voice and outspoken personality, William John Paul Gallagher, lead singer of Oasis and later Beady Eye, was born on this day in Manchester in 1972.

angles.name: Iconic Frontman
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! The iconic voice of Oasis and a true rock 'n' roll star. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' UK Single Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released in the UK on this day in 1975, four years after its initial album release in the US in 1971.

angles.name: Timeless Message
angles.copy: On this day in 1975, John Lennon's 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK. Its message of peace and unity remains as powerful today as ever.

events.title: Apple announced the first iPod 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the original iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising how people listened to music by putting '1,000 songs in your pocket'.

angles.name: Music Revolution
angles.copy: 25 years ago, Apple introduced the first iPod, a game-changer that put a thousand songs in our pockets and changed music listening forever. What was the first song you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day celebrates the premiere of the first James Bond film, 'Dr. No', in London on this day in 1962, launching one of the most successful film franchises in history.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: It's Global James Bond Day! Celebrating over six decades of 007, from iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme songs. What's your favourite Bond film or track?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Winston Ono Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles and an iconic solo artist, was born on this day in Liverpool in 1940.

angles.name: Remembering a Legend
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary English actor, comedian, screenwriter, and Monty Python co-founder, John Marwood Cleese, was born on this day in Weston-super-Mare in 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Genius
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! A true titan of British comedy, from Monty Python to Fawlty Towers. What's his funniest moment for you?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: Iconic Double Album
angles.copy: On this day in 1968, The Beatles released their iconic double album, 'The White Album'. A truly diverse and experimental masterpiece. What's your standout track?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury, 35 years on
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the iconic lead vocalist of Queen, passed away on this day in 1991 at the age of 45. He would have been 80 years old in 2026.

angles.name: Legendary Performer
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, who left us 35 years ago today. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', on this day in 1965, marking a significant artistic shift for the band.

angles.name: Evolution of The Beatles
angles.copy: On this day in 1965, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul', an album that showcased their incredible evolution and songwriting depth. A true classic!

events.title: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years on
events.blurb: John Lennon was tragically killed on this day in New York City in 1980 at the age of 40. He would have been 86 years old in 2026.

angles.name: A Voice For Peace
angles.copy: 46 years ago today, we lost John Lennon, a voice that championed peace and imagination. His legacy lives on through his timeless music.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: David Robert Jones, globally known as David Bowie, was born on this day in Brixton, London, in 1947.

angles.name: Starman's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the iconic David Bowie, who would have celebrated his 80th birthday today. A true chameleon of rock and an artistic innovator.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Elvis Aaron Presley, the legendary 'King of Rock and Roll', was born on this day in Tupelo, Mississippi, in 1935.

angles.name: Hail to the King
angles.copy: Happy heavenly 92nd birthday to the one and only Elvis Presley! The King of Rock and Roll, whose music still moves generations.
